title: Add Concept Map Extraction and Lexicon In/Out Validation
purpose: Create a concept map from technical papers for agent reasoning while enforcing lexicon validation before and after every governed run.

meta.description: Maps concepts, claims, primitives, evidence, and paper sources into a reasoning graph.

relation_edge.relation_type: supports | depends_on | constrains | generalizes | contradicts | operationalizes | measures | falsifies | aliases | refines

agent_rules: Before a governed run, perform lexicon_in_check on all source terms, hypothesis terms, observables, and requested concepts.
During paper ingestion, extract concept nodes and relation edges from theoretical mapping, observables, results, falsification, and conclusion sections.
After report generation, perform lexicon_out_check on all newly introduced terms, labels, observables, and interpretations.
Any missing or unstable term must be added to lexicon_gap_queue.json with status GAP_OPEN.
A claim using GAP_OPEN terms cannot be classified above proposed_interpretation unless the term is scope-limited and operationalized.
Concept map edges must link to claim_id and evidence_id when used for reasoning.
Agents may reason over verified and supported edges; provisional edges must be marked as assumptions.

lexicon_in_check.when: before THEORIST finalizes hypothesis and before SIM_DESIGNER selects tools

lexicon_out_check.when: after RESEARCH_WRITER and before final claim gate

acceptance_criteria: Every governed run has lexicon_in_check and lexicon_out_check records.
Every technical paper produces or updates a paper_map entry.
Every claim in claim_registry links to at least one concept_id.
Every concept used in C4+ claims has lexicon validation status L2 or higher, or is explicitly scoped as provisional.
Any newly introduced term is routed to lexicon_gap_queue.json.
Agent reasoning can traverse concept_map_registry.json without bypassing claim status or language policy.
